mapper.insert: insert into tbl_member (member_no, member_name, member_id, member_pwd, member_phone, member_email, member_birth,member_address, member_gender, point) values (member_seq.nextval, #{memberName}, #{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberEmail}, #{memberBirth},#{memberAddress}, #{memberGender}, 1000)
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_member SET pwd = #{pwd}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, gender = #{gender}, email = #{email}, birth = #{birth}, address = #{address} WHERE id = #{id}
